challenge.method: Compared the publisher text to SPDX licenseText, including §8 termination, §11 arbitration, §12, and Exhibit A. Tested NPL 1.0 and MPL 1.1 as alternatives and checked the tag’s target object.
challenge.results: Both representations contain the 1.0 arbitration language and the Mozilla 1.0 notice immediately after §12. Neither contains the Netscape amendments or the 1.1 multiple-licensed-code section. Differences in wrapping, tabs, and the heading separator do not identify another edition.

limitations: The comparison establishes documentary correspondence. It does not establish byte identity, legal equivalence, or application to a work.
